instructions: A static one-page dashboard ranking the top 5 most impactful PostHog engineers from GitHub data. Impact = Ship + Fix + Unblock points (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-22-impact-dashboard-design.md and AGENTS.md). Prioritize: scoring that deviates from the design, PRs counted in two pillars, bots leaking into rankings, numbers shown without a derivation, incomplete pagination or date windows, tokens leaking into output, and UI that breaks the single-screen layout or one theme. Be specific, cite the line, skip praise.

rules.rule: A PR must score under exactly one of Ship or Fix. Flag any path that can add the same PR to both.
Scoring weights must come only from src/lib/weights.ts, and the methodology UI must render them from there rather than hard-coding numbers.
Bot accounts must be excluded from rankings using the shared bot filter. Flag ranking code that bypasses it.
The browser must never call the GitHub API; it reads public/data.json only.
GitHub tokens must never be written to data files, logs or committed files.
